hooks.command: IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/claude_hook_guard.py" ignore PreToolUse; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/directive_recall.py"; fi

IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/claude_hook_guard.py" ignore PreToolUse && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/directive_prefilter.py"; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/directive_recall.py"; fi
IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/rulebook_hook.py" pre; fi

hooks.statusMessage: MemHub: checking directives for this failure
hooks.command: IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/claude_hook_guard.py" ignore PostToolUse && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/reactive_prefilter.py"; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/directive_recall.py"; fi

IN=$(cat); case "$IN" in *git*commit*|*"gh pr"*) if [ -z "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then echo "[memhub-flush] CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unset; cannot locate flush scripts, skipping" >&2; elif printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/claude_hook_guard.py" ignore PostToolUse && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/flush_prefilter.py"; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/flush_session.py"; fi ;; esac

IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/claude_hook_guard.py" ignore PostToolUse; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/artifact_sync_reminder.py"; fi

hooks.statusMessage: MemHub: PR created — arming babysit loop
hooks.command: IN=$(cat); case "$IN" in *gh*pr*create*) if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/claude_hook_guard.py" ignore PostToolUse; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/pr_babysit_trigger.py"; fi ;; esac

IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/claude_hook_guard.py" ignore PostToolUse; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/md_capture.py"; fi
IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/rulebook_hook.py" post; fi

IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/claude_hook_guard.py" ignore SessionStart; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/capture_health.py"; fi

IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/claude_hook_guard.py" ignore SessionStart; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/brain_brief.py" brief; fi
IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/rulebook_hook.py" session; fi

IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/claude_hook_guard.py" capture Stop && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/turn_flush_prefilter.py"; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/flush_turn.py"; fi

IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/claude_hook_guard.py" ignore Stop; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/brain_brief.py" refresh; fi

IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/claude_hook_guard.py" ignore Stop; then printf %s "$IN" | uv run --with 'mcp<2' python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/md_capture_flush.py"; fi
IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/rulebook_hook.py" flush; fi

IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/claude_hook_guard.py" capture SessionEnd; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/flush_session.py"; fi
IN=$(cat); if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/rulebook_hook.py" flush final; fi
